data.name: Water Bill Rebate ₱50
data.rule: Rebate for water bill payments posted under a Bataan Water District account.

data.name: Electricity Bill Rebate ₱100
data.rule: Rebate for electricity bill payments of ₱1,000 or more. One rebate per meter per month.

data.name: Fiber Internet Bill Rebate ₱30
data.rule: Rebate for fiber internet bill payments of Bataan area providers.

data.name: Mobile Load Cashback ₱20
data.rule: Cashback for prepaid load top-ups of ₱100 or more to any Philippine mobile number.

data.name: Water Bill Saver ₱15
data.rule: Small rebate for any posted water bill payment in Bataan. Stacks with the ₱50 rebate.
